name: reciprocating_compressor_exponent_m
title: Best speed exponent m for a family of reciprocating compressors
summary: Six Grasso reciprocating compressors given by identified polynomial isentropic-efficiency curves at three speeds over a 50-point pressure-ratio lookup table; the efficiency at lower speeds is simulated by scaling the 1500 rev/min curve with (rpm1/rpm2)^m, as in the original.

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution of Exponent m.EES by compare_solution.py (no --ees-units; no pressure/energy in the window): 1855 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: i (the DUPLICATE index). Largest relative difference 2.54e-10 on R_P_CP[3] (stored-solution rounding).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of thermo_models TM-0283 (Exponent m.EES, EES X6.596, 1856/1856); tools/compare_solution.py
verification.notes: The default lookup table (50x1, R_P_CP 1.662 to 6.141) was hand-decoded from the binary .ees at offset 238114 (ees_extract.py reports 0 tables) and agrees with the stored R_P_CP[1..50] to <=5e-10.
